title: Private deploy install standup + blockers (VPC / on-prem) — Mar 2026 weeklog
content:
Purpose
- Weekly standup notes and action tracker for private deployments (VPC + on-prem installs). Focus this week: two active installs (Acme Financial, NilaHealth), kernel/CNI issues, cert rotation behind proxy, and KMS/HSM validation.

Summary (high level)
- Acme Financial: onboarding blocked by CNI conflict + corporate proxy (customer infra team). Cannot establish node to node KV cache replication (timeouts).
- NilaHealth: initial install complete, failing cert rotation and metrics exporter (mTLS). We have a workaround but need a permanent fix in the install Helm chart.
- Internal: added a diagnostic flag to installer to capture kubelet logs earlier in the flow (PR ready). Autoscaler overlay fixed for dedicated resource pools.

Day-by-day standups (concise)
2026-03-09 (Mon)
- Aisha: ran remote debug with Acme infra (screen share). Identified CNI plugin: customer uses a custom Calico fork with iptables changes; our CNI init assumes calico v3.25+ features.
- Mateo: reproduced iptables race locally using minikube + custom calico image. Created repro script (scripts/repro-cni-race.sh).
- Priya: updated installer to add CNI readiness probe timeout toggle (flag: --cni-ready-wait).
- Action: Mateo to open PD-1047 with repro notes + suggested patch.

2026-03-10 (Tue)
- Customer call with Acme: proxy intercepting cert requests, breaks CSR flow to KMS. They will route internal CA requests through proxy bypass for our pods (security signoff pending).
- Tom: logged network packet captures (pcap) and shared to #pd-install-ops. Found TLS renegotiation that proxies drop.
- Action: Aisha to draft short runbook steps for customers using transparent proxies.

2026-03-11 (Wed)
- NilaHealth: cert-rotation job failed with exit code 1; logs show: "error: unable to verify cert chain: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority" during kubelet boot because we install our CA after kubelet starts.
- Mitigation: added preflight hook in installer to inject CA into node cert store before kubelet starts. Patch in PR: GH:redwood/deploy-runbooks#421.
- Action: Priya to test on ubuntu-20.04 nodes and on CentOS 8 (customer uses RHEL-like base).

2026-03-12 (Thu)
- Deep dive on KV cache replication timeouts with Mateo + SRE. Reproducer shows NAT timeouts when pod egress uses customer NAT gateway with port mapping.
- Hypothesis: connection tracking table size is small; long-running SSE connections get dropped, which kills replication.
- Action: SRE to propose sysctl recommendations for customer (net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max). Drafted notes in Confluence link.

Primary blockers (current)
- CNI compatibility (Acme Financial): custom Calico fork incompatible with our assumptions. Impact: stops node networking and KV replication. Owner: Mateo. ETA: 2026-03-18 for compatibility shim or explicit docs for customer CNI flags.
- Proxy + CSR/KMS path (Acme): corporate proxy drops TLS renegotiation. Impact: cert issuance fails; cannot complete seed. Owner: Aisha. Mitigation in progress (proxy-bypass guidance). Need security signoff from customer.
- Cert rotation race (NilaHealth): kubelet starts before CA installed. Impact: nodes show as NotReady intermittently. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-03-13 for validated installer change.
- HSM/KMS integration test failing (internal): HSM tests show intermittent auth failures on pkcs11 slot reset. Impact: blocks final verification for Private Prod. Owner: Lena. Next step: reproduce with vendor toolkit and escalate to vendor support.

Notes from customer calls / specific asks
- Acme Financial: "We cannot change our Calico fork immediately — asking Redwood to support a compatibility mode."
  - Follow-up: we can ship a compatibility shim (init container) that rewrites iptables rules to expected format; requires deep testing.
- NilaHealth infra: prefers certs managed by their internal Vault. They asked for an install flag --external-ca=true and an example pipeline.
  - Follow-up: add external-ca example to runbook + a short CI test to validate.

Work items and owners (short tracker)
- PD-1021: Add CNI readiness toggle + logging (PR opened) — Owner: Priya — target merge 2026-03-13.
- PD-1047: CNI race repro + suggested shim — Owner: Mateo — description + test matrix added 2026-03-10.
- PD-1052: Installer preflight CA injection (NilaHealth fix) — Owner: Priya — test on CentOS pending.
- PD-1059: KMS/HSM intermittent auth debugging — Owner: Lena — vendor support ticket opened 2026-03-11.
- PD-1063: Runbook section for proxy bypass + corporate proxies — Owner: Aisha — draft shared 2026-03-10.

Quick diagnostics and tips (copyable)
- Repro CNI race locally: 
  ./scripts/repro-cni-race.sh --calico-image calico/custom:fork-2026 --kube-version 1.26
- Check kubelet CA timing: 
  journalctl -u kubelet -b | grep -i CA
- Packet capture for proxy issue (tcpdump on node): 
  sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/proxy-conn.pcap port 443 and host KMS_IP

Decisions made this week
- Ship installer preflight CA injection as a hotfix for NilaHealth. Rationale: minimal risk and high customer impact.
- Prioritize compatibility shim for Calico fork over asking customers to immediately flip infra flags.

Open questions / unknowns
- Is compatibility shim safe across versions of iptables vs nftables? Need matrix testing.
- For HSM, is slot reset behavior expected for the vendor's firmware version? Vendor says no; need root cause.
- Should we add an automated scenario in CI that runs with a corporate proxy simulation? Pros: catch issues earlier. Cons: added maintenance.

Action item status (owner / deadline)
- Mateo: PD-1047 repro + shim prototype — due 2026-03-18 — status: in progress
- Priya: PD-1052 preflight CA injection tests on CentOS — due 2026-03-13 — status: testing
- Aisha: PD-1063 proxy runbook draft + customer signoff note — due 2026-03-12 — status: shared with Acme
- Lena: PD-1059 escalate HSM intermittent auth to vendor — due 2026-03-15 — status: vendor ticket opened

Notes to self / TODO (quick brain dump)
- Add example external-ca pipeline (Vault) to runbook — small doc + sample K8s manifests.
- Add sysctl recommendations to installer docs and config snippet for customers with NAT gateways.
- Preflight: verify kubelet binary order on supported OS images (move CA injection to earliest possible step).
- Consider adding an "install-dryrun" mode that simulates proxy + NAT to catch these network edge cases.

Meeting attachments / artifacts referenced
- pcap files: /shared/pcaps/acme-proxy-2026-03-10.pcap (internal share)
- PRs: GH:redwood/deploy-runbooks#421 (preflight CA), GH:redwood/installer#780 (cni readiness flag)

Next meeting
- Weekly private-deploy sync: Monday 2026-03-16 09:30 PT — focus: ship CA preflight, review shim prototype, and customer signoff on proxy bypass.

End of log.

(rough notes, please clean up before attaching to customer-facing ticket)
